newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: REVISED 1996 TRADE DEFICIT 4.816 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: REVISED 1996 TRADE DEFICIT 4.816 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's statistics department said on Tuesday that it has revised the 1996 foreign trade deficit to 4.816 billion litas from 4.499 billion litas.
The trade deficit was 3.774 billion litas in 1995.

The statistics department also said in a statement that the exports in 1996 were 13.42 billion litas, a 24 percent rise from 1995. Imports in 1996 stood at 18.24 billion litas, a 25 percent increase from the previous year.
The main trading partners in 1996 were Russia with 24 percent of exports and 29 percent of imports followed by Germany on 12.8 and 15.4 percent and Belarus at 10.2 percent and 2.4.
Exports to European Union countries amounted to 42.4 percent of total exports and 39.8 percent of imports in 1996.
Lithuania's exports to CIS countries stood at 45.4 percent and imports were 36.2 percent in 1996.
